'''Gavon Kroan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed at the [[Drift Hills Republic depot]], he sent the first squad of [[Recon Company]] &mdash; men he personally trained &mdash; on a routine check into nearby caves. When they did not return in time, he got worried and asked a skilled Republic operative to rescue them. Thanks to his timely actions, all men were returned to base safely.
